metadata.datasource: ILFORD ORTHO Plus fact sheet (August 2004), vector paths: spectral sensitivity (p1; the curve set as the filled outline of its stroke, its centre taken) and the pictorial-contrast characteristic curves (p3, ID-11 stock 8 and 10 min). Copy from 125px.com's archive of ILFORD documents.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 354-566 nm: the "wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K)" taken as drawn; ASSUMED its 0-1 "Sensitivity" axis is log units and the source is not divided out (as HP5 Plus); orthochromatic: no sensitivity beyond the sheet's 565 nm (the tail falls away); ASSUMED held below 354 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0773 dex/nm above 566 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -3.28..0.71 (ID-11 stock, 20 C, the lower of the two pictorial-contrast curves (G0.80): the one curve the sheet plots; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.887); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 1.013 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: ASSUMED: the sheet's exposure axis is relative. 0 = one log unit above the curve's own D = base+fog + 0.1 point, i.e. the film is taken to have exactly its rated speed (ISO 80: log10(0.8/80)+1.0 = -1.000 log lux-s)
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0547 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
